purpose: Define equivalent verification obligations for every first-class VyrnForge web surface without requiring identical framework tooling.

coverage.rationale: React runtime behavior has direct Vitest/V8 instrumentation in the React package.
The Custom Element runtime has direct Vitest/V8 instrumentation in the ui-elements package.

Angular's thin generated facade is verified through Angular compilation, package tests, catalog/peer-policy checks, packed consumer runtime, shared browser/accessibility scenarios, and SSR/bundler evidence instead of duplicating line-coverage instrumentation.

Vue's thin generated facade is verified through package tests, type/SFC/model/SSR checks, packed consumer runtime, shared browser/accessibility scenarios, and SSR/bundler evidence instead of duplicating line-coverage instrumentation.

benchmarkingPolicy: Performance benchmarking is workload-driven and is not a generic first-class-surface verification obligation.
